# Weekly show

Level, time and source of a question; choosing questions; building the line-up with its difficulty curve; the rundown; and checking levels against real answers.

[DifficultyMeter](#difficultymeter) · [TimeDial](#timedial) · [SourceField](#sourcefield) · [SourceBadge](#sourcebadge) · [QuestionPicker](#questionpicker) · [EpisodeBuilder](#episodebuilder) · [EpisodeCard](#episodecard) · [RunOfShow](#runofshow) · [DifficultyCalibration](#difficultycalibration)

### DifficultyMeter

The difficulty of a question as a ladder of five growing bars: Warm-up, Easy, Medium, Hard, Finale. Read-only it is a small badge; with `onChange` it is a picker of real radio buttons.

```ts
import { DifficultyMeter } from '@/contest/components/DifficultyMeter'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Difficulty` |  | The level, 1 to 5. Empty shows "Not set". |
| `onChange` | `(level: Difficulty) => void` |  | Makes it a picker. Arrow keys move between the five choices. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` | The size of the ladder. |
| `compact` | `boolean` |  | In the picker: one slim row, without the hints. |
| `showName` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the level name next to the read-only ladder. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<DifficultyMeter value={question.difficulty} size="sm" />
<DifficultyMeter value={level} onChange={setLevel} compact />
```

- Colour is never the only cue: every level also has a name and a number of filled bars. The colours come from `--level-1` to `--level-5`.

### TimeDial

How long people get to answer: a row of usual times, a box for any other, and a suggestion that fits the type and level of the question. The seconds to read the question are shown on top.

```ts
import { TimeDial } from '@/contest/components/TimeDial'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` *(required)* | `number` |  | Seconds to answer. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(seconds: number) => void` |  | Called with the new time. |
| `question` | `Pick<Question, 'type' \| 'difficulty'>` |  | Used to suggest a time: true or false about 15 s, a hard multiple choice more. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<TimeDial value={q.timeLimitSec ?? 20} question={q} onChange={(timeLimitSec) => setQ({ ...q, timeLimitSec })} />
```

### SourceField

Where the answer to a question was checked: kind, title, address, and whether an editor verified it. Warns when the source is only Wikipedia. SourceBadge is the small pill that shows how far a source can be trusted.

```ts
import { SourceField } from '@/contest/components/SourceField'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `QuestionSource` |  | The source, or nothing yet. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(source: QuestionSource \| undefined) => void` |  | Called with the new source. |
| `reviewer` | `string` | `'Editor'` | Written next to the date when "I checked the answer" is ticked. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<SourceField value={q.source} onChange={(source) => setQ({ ...q, source })} reviewer="Ada" />
<SourceBadge source={q.source} />
```

- Changing the title or the address clears "checked", because the check was for the old source.
- Sources are for editors. Participants never see them.

### SourceBadge

A small pill that says how far a question's source can be trusted: Verified, Original, Not checked, Wikipedia only, or No source.

```ts
import { SourceBadge } from '@/contest/components/SourceBadge'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | `QuestionSource` |  | The source. Without one the pill says "No source". |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<SourceBadge source={question.source} />
```

### QuestionPicker

The question bank as cards for choosing what goes on air. Each card shows level, time, source trust, how people really answered it and when it was last used. Filter by topic, level, "not used lately" and "source checked".

```ts
import { QuestionPicker } from '@/contest/components/QuestionPicker'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `questions` *(required)* | `Question[]` |  | The bank. |
| `keys` *(required)* | `Record<string, AnswerKey>` |  | The answer keys, to tell which questions can run live. |
| `stats` *(required)* | `Record<string, QuestionStat>` |  | Past results by question id. See `questionStats`. |
| `picked` *(required)* | `string[]` |  | Ids already in the show; their cards say so. |
| `onAdd` *(required)* | `(question: Question) => void` |  | Called when "Add to the show" is pressed. |
| `onRemove` | `(question: Question) => void` |  | Lets the card of a picked question remove it again. |
| `freshDays` | `number` | `56` | "Not used lately" means not used within this many days. |
| `now` | `Date` |  | Replaces the clock, for tests and demos. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<QuestionPicker questions={bank} keys={keys} stats={stats} picked={pickedIds} onAdd={(q) => addSlot(q.id)} />
```

- A question that cannot run live (a draft, an incomplete key, or one a person has to score) shows why and cannot be added.

### EpisodeBuilder

Builds the line-up of a weekly show. Three views at once: the running order (drag to reorder, set each time), the difficulty curve against the usual build-up, and the time bar against the broadcast slot. Checks say what is wrong before it goes on air.

```ts
import { EpisodeBuilder } from '@/contest/components/EpisodeBuilder'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `episode` *(required)* | `Episode` |  | The show being built. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(episode: Episode) => void` |  | Called with the whole updated show. |
| `questions` *(required)* | `Question[]` |  | The whole bank, to look the slots up. |
| `keys` *(required)* | `Record<string, AnswerKey>` |  | The answer keys, for the checks. |
| `stats` *(required)* | `Record<string, QuestionStat>` |  | Past results: the curve shows where people found a question harder or easier than its level. |
| `onAddQuestions` | `() => void` |  | Shows an "Add questions" button: open your picker. |
| `onSuggest` | `() => void` |  | Shows a "Fill from the bank" button. See `suggestEpisode`. |
| `polls` | `Survey[]` | `[]` | Surveys that can run as a poll during the show. Without any, the poll button is hidden. |
| `pack` | `{ ids: ReadonlySet<string>; revision: number }` |  | The pack in force: a question that is approved but not in it gets a warning. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<EpisodeBuilder episode={draft} onChange={setDraft} questions={bank} keys={keys} stats={stats} onAddQuestions={() => setPicking(true)} onSuggest={fill} />
```

- The checks come from `episodeChecks`: a missing source, a flat curve, too many hard questions, a show that runs over, a question that needs a person to score it. Click a check to jump to its row.

### EpisodeCard

One show of the weekly calendar: number and day, a strip of difficulty bars (the shape of the show at a glance), and either the time to go or how it went.

```ts
import { EpisodeCard } from '@/contest/components/EpisodeCard'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `episode` *(required)* | `Episode` |  | The show. |
| `questions` *(required)* | `Question[]` |  | The bank, for the levels. |
| `onOpen` | `(episode: Episode) => void` |  | Makes the card a button. |
| `selected` | `boolean` |  | Marks it as the open one. |
| `now` | `() => number` |  | Replaces the clock of the countdown. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<EpisodeCard episode={next} questions={bank} onOpen={(e) => setOpen(e.id)} />
```

### RunOfShow

The rundown sheet of a show: every item with the clock time it starts, how long it runs, and a bar for its length. The lobby opens before the start; the last row says when the show goes off air.

```ts
import { RunOfShow } from '@/contest/components/RunOfShow'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `episode` *(required)* | `Episode` |  | The show. |
| `questions` *(required)* | `Question[]` |  | The bank, for the times. |
| `now` | `number` |  | Highlights the item on air at this moment (server milliseconds). |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<RunOfShow episode={episode} questions={bank} now={serverNow} />
```

### DifficultyCalibration

The level a writer gave against how people really answered. A chart (a dot above the band is easier than written, below is harder) and a list of the questions that do not fit, with a "Move to …" action and a flag for questions that do not separate strong players from weak ones.

```ts
import { DifficultyCalibration } from '@/contest/components/DifficultyCalibration'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `questions` *(required)* | `Question[]` |  | The bank. |
| `stats` *(required)* | `Record<string, QuestionStat>` |  | Past results by question id. See `questionStats`. |
| `onApply` | `(question: Question, level: Difficulty) => void` |  | Shows a "Move to …" button where the level does not fit. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<DifficultyCalibration questions={bank} stats={questionStats(bank, episodes)} onApply={(q, level) => save({ ...q, difficulty: level })} />
```

- A level is trusted only after 30 answers. Hollow dots do not have enough yet.
- Discrimination below 0.25 means the top and the bottom players did about equally well: the question tells little.
